title: Gross
text: Gross. I wanted to like this but I can't see how anyone gives this higher stars. I like making my own dressings, but when you pour it out, it makes the spout dirty. You can wipe it down with a towel to try and clean it, but it's basically like leaving an open jar in the fridge. Part of it is always going to be exposed to the dirty pour spout that isn't cleaned properly. When you repour, it has to pass the dirty spout and onto your food. So it's fine if you're only making a vinaigrette, but if you're making anything besides that (imagine milk based dressing), it's gross. I'd rather just use a mason jar that you can throw back in the fridge and has a solid lid that doesn't expose the dressing. I suppose it would work if you took it with you on a picnic for a big crowd and used all of the mixture in one shot, but that wasn't the appeal that I initially bought it for.

features: Ideal for making, mixing, serving and storing dressings, sauces and marinades
Wide opening accommodates a range of ingredients
1.5-cup (355 mL) capacity with measurement markings in cups, ounces and milliliters
One-handed open/close lever flips back to pour and forward to seal
Made from Tritan, dishwasher safe, durable and BPA free
BPA free, break-resistant and dishwasher safe
description: Mix, serve and store dressings, sauces, marinades and more with the OXO Good Grips Salad Dressing Shaker. The wide Shaker top unscrews for adding a range of ingredients like oil, vinegar, mayonnaise, mustard, garlic, onions and spices. Cup, milliliter and ounce markings are printed on the side for easy measuring. Once ingredients are added, simply screw the top closed and shake the watertight container to quickly mix. Flip the top lever back to pour and forward to seal. The 1.5-cup-capacity Shaker is dishwasher safe, highly durable and BPA free.
